project_type: React SPA with Vite bundler, Tailwind CSS v4, localStorage persistence
build_system: npm + Vite 8. Use --legacy-peer-deps for npm install due to eslint peer dep conflict.
test_framework: Vitest with @testing-library/react, jsdom environment. Test utils in src/test/utils.jsx wrap components in MemoryRouter + AppProvider. Factories in src/test/factories/. Playwright for e2e (tests/e2e/).
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx vitest run to confirm all tests pass. 2. Run npx vite build to confirm build succeeds. 3. Run npx eslint . to check lint (may have warnings).
environment_constraints: NODE_OPTIONS must be unset before running npm/node commands (sandbox pre-sets a broken --require path). Use 'unset NODE_OPTIONS &&' before all node commands.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md present. Follow existing patterns: lazy-loaded pages, AppContext for state, localStorage via src/lib/storage.js, Tailwind CSS for styling, lucide-react for icons.
key_patterns: Pages are lazy-loaded in App.jsx. AppContext provides global state + localStorage persistence. Test factories (nurseFactory, documentFactory, placementFactory) generate test data. Integration tests use custom render from src/test/utils.jsx. Toast notifications via AppContext addToast/dismissToast. LoadingSpinner component for loading states.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - 17 page components (lazy-loaded), src/components/ - organized by domain (ui/, layout/, nurses/, placements/, etc.), src/context/ - AppContext global state, src/lib/ - utilities (storage, formatUtils, etc.), src/data/ - seed data generators, src/test/ - test utilities and factories, tests/e2e/ - Playwright tests (mostly skipped stubs)
